source_caption:
Anna (2019) — blends stylish espionage, brutal action, and nonstop twists into a sleek assassin thriller. Directed by Luc Besson, the film follows Anna Poliatova, played by Sasha Luss, a young Russian woman whose modeling career hides a far more dangerous reality as a highly trained KGB assassin.

What starts as a straightforward spy story quickly becomes layered with shifting timelines, double-crosses, and hidden motives. Much like Besson’s earlier films such as La Femme Nikita and Léon: The Professional, the movie mixes elegance and violence, presenting Anna as both vulnerable and extremely lethal.

One of the film’s standout moments is a long restaurant fight sequence that was praised for its choreography and fast, fluid camera work. Sasha Luss, who had mostly been known as a fashion model before the film, surprised many viewers with the physicality and confidence she brought to the role. The cast also includes Helen Mirren, Cillian Murphy, and Luke Evans.

Beneath the stylish action and espionage, Anna is really about control and survival. Nearly every character is manipulating someone else, and the film constantly asks whether true freedom is even possible in a world built on secrets and power.

source_details.synopsis: Anna (stylized as ANИA) is a 2019 action thriller film written, produced and directed by Luc Besson. The film stars Sasha Luss as the eponymous assassin, alongside Luke Evans, Cillian Murphy, Helen Mirren, and Alexander Petrov. The French production was theatrically released in the United States on 21 June 2019 by Summit Entertainment and on 10 July 2019 by Pathé Distribution in France. It received mixed reviews from critics and grossed $32 million worldwide against a $30 million budget.
